chapter: What You Would Feel (first minute — floating through one second)
carry: Teaspoon grammar: when VO names a thing, that thing is the picture.
Mute test. Physics-led tidal stretch — not gore.
At most one Orbit+distant-remnant hang — this minute: ZERO remnant hangs.
No cartoon mouths. One face, two arms, orange back on turns.

plates.vo_idea: Falling in a uniform field can feel like floating.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. Orbit FLOATS in a uniform field — weightless, calm, drifting. One visor FACEPLATE, TWO arms, cream eyes with pupils, small underside glow not flame. NO remnant, NO distant star as destination. HARD FORBIDDEN: two faces, four arms, cartoon mouth, flame jet, Orbit-plus-tiny-distant-dot wallpaper, knockoff. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: Near a neutron star, the field is not uniform over your height.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. Orbit's HEIGHT is the subject — antenna to underside glow — the field differing over that length. He BRACES, slightly taller in frame. One face, TWO arms. HARD FORBIDDEN: two faces, cartoon mouth, gore, four arms, remnant hang, knockoff. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: The pull on your nearer side outruns the pull on your farther side.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. Tidal pull: Orbit's NEARER side is yanked harder than the far side — he TIPS and STRETCHES slightly toward the stronger pull. Physics-led, not gore. One visor FACEPLATE, TWO arms. HARD FORBIDDEN: blood, gore, cartoon mouth, two faces, four arms, knockoff. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: That difference — the tide — is what turns approach into dissection.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. GOLD BEAT: THE TIDE. Orbit is stretched along one axis by differential gravity — spaghetti-like elongation, still ONE Orbit, ONE visor FACEPLATE, TWO arms. Physics-led dissection of shape, NOT gore, NOT blood. HARD FORBIDDEN: blood, viscera, cartoon mouth, two faces, twins, knockoff. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: Would you feel yourself being crushed — or would it be too fast?
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. Close visor FACEPLATE — the question on the eyes. Cream eyes with pupils. One face, TWO arms. He flinches as if time is about to run out. HARD FORBIDDEN: cartoon mouth, two faces, gore, four arms, knockoff. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: Structures fail. Chemistry fails. The narrative of a continuous self ends.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. A crystalline LATTICE / structure CRACKS and fails — chemistry coming apart. Abstract physics, not a body, not gore. NO Orbit. HARD FORBIDDEN: blood, viscera, Orbit, oval sprites, HUD labels, flat discs. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, continuous motion ~8s.

IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame. ONE SECOND as a pulse of light in vacuum — a single bright tick that blooms then fades. Not a clock, not a HUD, not digits. NO Orbit. HARD FORBIDDEN: readable text, countdown timer, UI, Orbit, flat discs. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.

plates.vo_idea: It depends where that second is spent.
plates.prompt: IMAGE-TO-VIDEO of the attached start frame COMPOSITION. Tiny on-model Orbit far from a SOFT radial gravity well — WHERE the second is spent is the picture. He drifts, deciding distance. One visor FACEPLATE, TWO arms. HARD FORBIDDEN: second remnant disc, clipped sphere, cartoon mouth, two faces, four arms, Orbit as giant foreground hero, knockoff. Premium cinematic 3D CGI, vacuum, continuous motion ~8s.
